name: Arugula-Tempeh Salad with Blistered Tomatoes, Avocado & Chive Dressing
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tempeh. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with soy sauce, and stir to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tempeh and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 5-7 minutes. Transfer tempeh to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet and bowl for later use.)
While the tempeh is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown and burst, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the reserved bowl.

Chop chives into small pieces. Add half to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo, oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
Add arugula and cooled tomatoes to the bowl with the dressing. Gently toss to combine the salad.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and large dice. Season with salt.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with avocado, tempeh, and reserved chives. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
